column1: # Published MVA / PCS patient cohort — genotype, tumour spectrum, age at first tumour.
# SCOPE: published patients only. Every row traces to a PMID. The hackathon proband is
# NOT a row and must never be added: fewer than 50 MVA patients are described worldwide,
# and that is the same number that makes re-identification possible.
# SOURCE GRADE: "abstract" = extracted from the PubMed abstract/title only; "fulltext" =
# extracted from full text held in literature/. Rows graded "abstract" carry only what the
# abstract states, and blank means "not stated in the abstract", never "absent in the patient".
# "reg" was not one of the three classes this task was specified to expect; it was added
# because two independent pedigrees carry it.
# AGE_FIRST_TUMOUR is in years unless stated. "n/r" = no tumour reported at last follow-up,
# which in an ascertainment-biased case series is NOT evidence of absence of risk.
